theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  let k' : Subfield K := k
  have h_field : IsField k' := field_of_subfield k'
  have h_alg : IsAlgebraic ℚ k' := algebraic_of_subfield k'
  have h_subalg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k' := Algebra.isAlgebraic_subfield k'
  exact Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans h_subalg (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isAlgebraic h_alg)
